title: Positive odd-Matsubara resolvent expansion of the capped Gibbs kernel
question: Can the exact theta-half hyperbolic-tangent Gibbs kernel be decomposed into positive odd-Matsubara resolvent layers so that future locality estimates can be proved layer by layer without a uniform spectral gap?
promotion_boundary: R-374 is a finite scalar resolvent-layer interface. It checks positivity, monotone partial sums and an explicit tail envelope for the odd-Matsubara expansion on actual-Q3 bond spectra and all history prefixes; it does not prove resolvent locality or any uniform Q3 estimate.
next_action: Prove a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform locality estimate for each positive odd-Matsubara resolvent layer on a Hamiltonian-derived common core, then sum the layers with a controlled tail.
boundary: Finite doubled-bond Gibbs proxy, all-prefix actual-Q3 edge and square rows, both orientations, signs, adjoints and beta values. The scalar series identity is used as a proposed analytic interface and finite partial sums are checked; resolvent locality, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
